CAM_T5_01_MOUNTAIN_WIDE.description: Wide mountain landscape — the NW01 range (snowy range ≈100 km NW of the Ashram) from a high shoulder south of the main summit

CAM_T5_02_FOREST_ESTABLISHING.description: Forest establishing shot — edge of the northern forest belt where the river enters it (FH, 2 m terrain + real trees)

CAM_T5_03_RIVER_WATERFALL.description: River + waterfall — wide cascade, 6 tiers, 376 m total drop (NW01 gorge), ballistic spray + mist

CAM_T5_04_SNOWY_PEAKS.description: Snowy mountain — highest summit of NW01 (5809 m) from the SSE, glaciers / couloirs / rock bands

CAM_T5_06_VALLEY_AERIAL.description: Valley aerial — Ashram Valley from the SE: open green floor, groves, the rivers, the northern forest belt, the range on the horizon

CAM_T5_07_GROUND_LEVEL.description: Ground level (1.6 m eye) — river meadow beside the Ashram pad: grass, wild flowers, river stones, groves, range on the horizon

CAM_T5_08_FOREST_FLOOR.description: Ground level in the forest — forest floor, ferns, roots, fallen logs, mossy rocks, fir / pine trunks

CAM_T5_05_DESERT.description: Desert landscape — R04 Western Desert: wind-shaped dune field, sandstone butte with strata, desert pavement

CAM_T5_05B_DESERT_MESAS_AERIAL.description: Desert aerial — dune seas between mesas / buttes, dry wadis and playas (cracked ground)

CAM_T5_09_FORBIDDEN_RIM.description: Forbidden Region (R05) — the blasted crater rim: ash ground, fissures, dead trees, the dark crater lake beyond

CAM_T5_09B_FORBIDDEN_AERIAL.description: Forbidden Region aerial — ejecta ridges on the blasted plain, the crater rim and the crater lake
